findings.text: follow-on: the FPPC assertion compares _coil_drive_weight against a sum the test computes from the same products the function it calls sums, so it holds whatever the function does; the independent anchors are the catalogue read at :396 and the CS1 refusal at :403.

follow-on: the agreement band is an absolute 0.011 on the per-element ampere-turns, so a genuine per-element disagreement up to 0.011 on a large-magnitude coil is accepted as rounding; the catalogue's two-decimal resolution makes this correct for the declared weights but the band no longer scales, so a future finer catalogue would need it retuned.
